case.pattern_description: Shared-device ring: one device profile (Windows | Windows 7 | chrome 65.0 | 1916x901), marked New for every account, behind a proxy (transparent), made purchases on 3 cards belonging to 3 different customers within 30 days. No single cardholder's behaviour explains it; the common element is the device. Found by expanding from the flagged transaction's device to every card that used it.

evidence.claim: Flagged $75.08 online purchase (product H) in billing region 325 on 2016-11-25 07:39; bank risk score 0.51, our transaction model 0.40 (model trained on the closed cases; ROC-AUC 0.95 vs 0.86 for the risk score on a Sep-Oct holdout)

Customer has 364 transactions in the prior 120 days; billing region 325 is familiar for the customer; device profile Windows | Windows 7 | chrome 65.0 | 1916x901 is not established and marked New for the account, connection through transparent proxy
No other transaction on the customer's cards in the 10-day window scores as likely fraud; the flagged transaction is isolated
Device profile Windows | Windows 7 | chrome 65.0 | 1916x901 (marked New for every account, behind a proxy (transparent)) was used on 3 cards of 3 customers in the prior 30 days

Behavioural nearest neighbours among closed cases: 3 of 5 confirmed fraud (CC-2774 card_not_present_new_device, d=0.3, CC-3915 card_not_present_new_device, d=0.3, CC-5037 card_not_present_new_device, d=0.4, CC-1030 none, d=0.4, CC-1238 none, d=0.5); closest cleared look-alikes: CC-1030 d=0.4, CC-1238 d=0.5, CC-0951 d=0.5
Policy rules applied: see next_best_actions reasons; thresholds from Fraud Policy v1.0 sections 2, 3, 3a and 6

sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-25 07:39 and 2016-11-25 07:39, 1 transaction(s) totalling $75.08 were made on card(s) C09149-K1 belonging to customer C09149. The activity comprised 1 online transaction(s) under product code(s) H, in billing region 325. Online transactions came from device profile(s) Windows | Windows 7 | chrome 65.0 | 1916x901. All came from device profile Windows | Windows 7 | chrome 65.0 | 1916x901, marked New for every account, behind a proxy (transparent). That device was used on 3 cards of 3 customers within 30 days, which no legitimate cardholder explains (policy R6). Total suspicious amount: $75.08. Actions recommended: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.
